params.label: Shopify Shop Alias
params.description: The part of your Shopify domain that comes before .myshopify.com; e.g. if your Shopify domain is https://myshop.myshopify.com, your alias is myshop.

params.label: Shopify Shop Domain
params.description: The full domain of your Shopify shop; e.g. myshop.com. This is optional and only needed if you have a custom domain for your Shopify shop.

params.label: Shopify Headless Storefront Access Token
params.description: The access token for your Shopify headless storefront.

params.label: Language
params.description: The locale code, affecting the default language for stock warnings etc. in the cart; e.g., en-US for English, de-DE for German.

params.label: Use Shopify company contacts
params.description: If checked, the extension will use Shopify company contacts to update the location on the cart.
